text:
Morning brief, Monday 27 April:
- 10:00 Planning, 11:30 call with Priya, 14:00 first round with Dhruv (with Priya).
- 15:00 kickoff call for the landing page illustrations, then Arjun at 15:30 on billing webhooks and export.
- Inbox is quiet. Your notes from Friday's call list Acme's vendor form from Sunita Pillai as the open item.
- Linear: the Monday critical-bug count is due in #eng-weekly at 10:00.
- Weather: humid, about 33 degrees by afternoon, a small chance of rain after 18:00.
Sources: Calendar, Mail, your notes, Linear, weather forecast.

[voice note] Morning. Skip the bug count today, Arjun's team is re-triaging severities this week so the numbers would be off. Do it next Monday instead. And can you sort out a call with Dev Anand at Brightline, I want to talk about our hosting tier before the renewal.
Skipping today's #eng-weekly bug count; I will run it next Monday, May 4, at 10:00. For Dev Anand: do you want me to propose specific slots, or just ask him to suggest some?
let him suggest. his team is in chennai and they never pick up before 11, so nothing earlier than that

I cannot message Dev Anand from your phone, but here is text you can paste:
'Hi Dev Anand, could we find 30 minutes this week to go over our hosting tier ahead of the renewal? Any time after 11:00 works for me, except Wednesday after 15:00. Rohan'
Want it as an email instead?
text is fine, I'll send it myself. make it thursday or friday only
Changed to: 'Could we find 30 minutes on Thursday or Friday, after 11:00?' Tell me what he picks and I will block it in your calendar.
weather today?
Mumbai: 32 degrees at noon, humid, around 20 percent chance of an evening shower. Take an umbrella if you are out after 18:00.
remind me 6:30pm to call Neha about sunday lunch
Set: today 18:30, call Neha about Sunday lunch.
Can you ask Priya for a short status on the mobile crash tickets before Thursday? Not chasing, I just want it ready for our check-in.

Draft Slack DM to Priya:
'Priya, could you send me two lines on where the mobile crash tickets stand before Thursday? No rush, Wednesday evening is fine. R.'
Thursday she works from Pune, so she will be on the phone for any call. Send as is?
send. and put 45 min with her thursday 12:30
Sent. Booked Thursday 30 April, 12:30 to 13:15, check-in with Priya; she joins by phone from Pune.
what's on today
10:00 Planning. 11:30 Priya. 14:00 Dhruv's first round. 15:00 illustration kickoff, then Arjun at 15:30. 18:30 is your reminder to call Neha, not a booking. Nothing after 16:00 that needs you.
joke. the planning meeting is running long
A tester walks into a bar and orders 1 beer, 0 beers, 99999 beers, -1 beers and a lizard. The first real customer asks where the bathroom is and the bar catches fire.
Post one line in #eng-weekly saying the bug count is skipped this week and back next Monday, so nobody wonders.
Posted in #eng-weekly: 'No critical-bug count today while Platform re-triages severities. It resumes Monday, May 4.'
Sunita's vendor form. What did she say it needs?

From your Friday call notes: company details, tax registration, an insurance certificate, a security questionnaire and a data-handling annex. She wants the completed form back by Friday, May 8. The questionnaire and the annex are the technical parts.
Arjun does the questionnaire and annex, I do the rest. Draft him a note.

Draft Slack DM to Arjun:
'Arjun, Sunita at Acme needs a vendor form back by Friday May 8. Two parts are yours: the security questionnaire and the data-handling annex. Could you take them? I will do company, tax and insurance. R.'
tighter, and say I need his part by Wednesday May 6 so I can review it
'Arjun, Acme's vendor form is due to Sunita on Friday May 8. Can you take the security questionnaire and the data-handling annex and get them to me by Wednesday May 6? I will cover the rest. R.'
good, send
Sent to Arjun. I will ask him for status on Tuesday, May 5, if I have not seen anything by then.
Send Maya the kickoff brief for the 3pm call, the one from my notes.
Which Maya? The only Maya I have on file is Maya Rao at Acme, and a kickoff brief for a design call does not sound like a proposal matter. Tell me who it is for before I send anything.
Maya Iyer is our freelance designer at Pixelbarn. She sends the invoices. Acme's Maya is Maya Rao.
Two Mayas: Maya Rao (Acme, the proposal) and Maya Iyer (Pixelbarn, design and invoices). I will not mix them up.
Yes, Maya Iyer. Send the illustrations brief from my notes: hero, three feature spots, one footer scene.
Sent to Maya Iyer at Pixelbarn: the landing page illustration brief with the hero, three feature spots and a footer scene, ahead of the 15:00 call. Arjun is not copied, since it is not Acme mail.
order lunch, same as friday
I cannot place orders, and I have no record of Friday's lunch. Tell me the dish and I will remind you to order by 13:00.
veg thali, extra roti, no sweet. remind me at 1
Set for 13:00: order veg thali, extra roti, no sweet.
Reminder: order lunch. Veg thali, extra roti, no sweet.

Dhruv's first round is today, 14:00 to 15:00 with Priya, and Anika's second round is Wednesday 29 April, 11:00 to 12:00 with Priya and Arjun. There is no further first-round slot yet.

Booked Tuesday May 5, 11:30 to 12:10, first round with Tanvi, panel you and Priya. I used the same 40 minutes as Isha and Kabir.
what did I say I want from the illustrations, call in 40

From your notes: a hero for the landing page, three feature spots, one footer scene. Flat style, two accent colours, nothing that looks like stock art. Questions you wanted to ask: timeline, fee, and whether the set works on light and dark backgrounds.

[voice note] Call's done. She'll do the hero, three feature spots and the footer scene. First pass Wednesday. We agreed forty-five thousand rupees for the whole set, she invoices when she delivers and I pay within fourteen days. I told her the hero might come out too dark, so lighter if she can. Save all that.

Saved: landing page illustrations with Maya Iyer (Pixelbarn): hero, three feature spots, footer scene. Fee INR 45,000 for the set, invoiced on delivery, payable within 14 days. First pass due Wednesday, April 29. Hero direction: lighter if possible.
sorry, first pass is Thursday not Wednesday. she said thursday
Corrected: first pass due Thursday, April 30.
I want a competitor price comparison for the pricing review. Ask Kavya to put it together.

Draft Slack DM to Kavya:
'Kavya, for the pricing review I would like a one-page comparison of what competitors charge, by plan. Can you share it by next Friday? R.'
Which Friday do you mean, May 1 or May 8?
May 8. May 1 is a holiday anyway. send
Sent to Kavya with the date: Friday, May 8. Noted that Friday May 1 is Maharashtra Day and Kestrel is closed.
wrap up

End of day, Monday:
- Done: Dhruv's first round, illustration kickoff (fee and timeline saved), design interviews slotted (Isha Tue, Kabir Thu, Tanvi Tue May 5), Arjun asked for the vendor form parts.
- Skipped on your instruction: #eng-weekly bug count, back May 4.
- Waiting: Dev Anand's slots, Priya's crash status, Kavya's price comparison (May 8).
- Tomorrow: Isha at 11:30, gym reminder 06:30.
Sources: Calendar, Slack, today's notes.
How many working days from tomorrow to May 29?
Tuesday April 28 through Friday May 29 is 24 weekdays, or 23 without Friday May 1. I only counted Maharashtra Day as a holiday; tell me if there are others.
Reminder: call Neha about Sunday lunch.
talked to her. sunday 1:30 at hers. need a housewarming gift, under 3000, ideas?
Three options under 3,000: a ceramic tea set with a tray, a pair of planters on a stand, or a hamper of loose-leaf teas. The tea set suits a first home best.
tea set. save it, I'll pick it up saturday
Saved: Neha's housewarming lunch Sunday May 3 at 13:30. Gift is a tea set, pickup on Saturday.
Send a note to the team about tomorrow: Isha's interview, the Acme vendor form, and that Friday is a holiday.

Which channel? #eng-weekly is for engineering updates and #ops is for support and ops, and this is neither. I can DM Priya, Arjun and Kavya individually, or post to a general channel if you tell me which one.
dm each of them, same text

Sent to Priya, Arjun and Kavya:
'Heads-up for the week: design interview with Isha tomorrow at 11:30 (Priya on the panel), Acme's vendor form is due to Sunita on Friday May 8, and Friday May 1 is Maharashtra Day, so we are closed. R.'
gym tomorrow 7, remind me at 6:30 this week instead of 6:15
Reminder set for 06:30 tomorrow: gym at 07:00. The wake message moves from 06:15 to 06:30 for now.
anything I forgot today
Nothing overdue. Open: Dev Anand's reply once you text him, Priya's crash status, Arjun's vendor form parts due May 6, Kavya's comparison due May 8.
ok night
Good night. Tomorrow: gym reminder at 06:30, brief at 08:30, Isha at 11:30.
Reminder: gym at 07:00.

Morning brief, Tuesday 28 April:
- 10:30 to 11:15: pricing approach with Priya, Arjun and Kavya; then 11:30 to 12:10 first-round interview with Isha for the design role. Priya is on the panel and is in Mumbai today.
- Waiting on you: Priya's mobile crash status (she has until Wednesday evening) and Dev Anand's reply to your text.
- #ops: overnight quiet, no open escalations as of 08:15.
- Weather: 33 degrees, showers possible after 19:00.
Sources: Calendar, Slack #ops, your messages from Monday, weather forecast.
Give me five questions for the portfolio walkthrough with Isha. Work process only.

1. Pick one project and walk me from the brief to what shipped. What changed along the way?
2. Where did you disagree with an engineer or a product person, and how did it end?
3. Which part of this portfolio would you redo today?
4. How do you decide what to cut when the deadline is fixed?
5. How do you check that a design worked after launch?
Cut it to three and add one on working with developers day to day.

1. Pick one project and walk me from the brief to what shipped. What changed on the way?
2. How do you decide what to cut when the deadline is fixed?
3. How do you check that a design worked after launch?
4. How do you work with developers day to day, and what do you hand over?
who's playing tonight
I do not have a sports schedule or live scores connected, so I cannot say. The broadcaster's app will have it.
Book 30 min with Imran this week to go over the MSA. He likes calls after 5, so Wednesday 5pm.
You take nothing on Wednesdays after 15:00, so 17:00 that day is out. Thursday 17:00 or 17:15 works, and Monday to Thursday after 17:00 are otherwise open. Thursday?
scratch wednesday, thursday 5:15 then
Booked: Thursday April 30, 17:15 to 17:45, call with Imran Qadri about the MSA. Saved that Imran prefers calls after 17:00.
Isha's interview starts at 11:30 and runs 40 minutes. Panel: you and Priya.
[voice note] That's done. Put the feedback forms on my list, mine and Priya's, due tomorrow end of day. And Kabir is Thursday at two, Priya will be on the phone from Pune, don't forget that.
Noted: interview feedback forms for Isha are due from you and Priya by end of day Wednesday, April 29. I will remind you at 16:30 tomorrow. Kabir is Thursday 14:00 with Priya joining by phone.
lunch ideas, light
After yesterday's thali: dal khichdi, curd rice or a grain salad. Khichdi is usually the quickest to arrive.
khichdi. ordering now
Good. Nothing else is booked this afternoon.
Deal with the vendor thing today.
Which one: the Brightline hosting tier call, or Acme's vendor form from Sunita? They need different things from me.
Brightline. I want last quarter's usage summary from Arjun before I speak to Dev Anand.

Added to the note I will send Arjun this afternoon: usage summary for last quarter, needed before the Dev Anand call. The call time is still unconfirmed, so I have asked for it by Wednesday evening to be safe.
Anything in #ops I should know about? I heard there's an escalation.

One open escalation, raised at 12:10: a customer reports exports timing out on large projects. It is assigned to Platform. Support has acknowledged it but given no ETA, and I cannot see the customer's account details from here.
Ask Arjun for an ETA by 3 and draft a holding reply support can send.

Draft Slack DM to Arjun:
'Arjun, the export timeout escalation in #ops: can you give me an ETA by 15:00? I want to tell the customer a time. Also, please add last quarter's usage summary to your list. R.'

Holding reply for support:
'Hi, thanks for flagging the export timeouts. Our engineers are working on it and we will update you by tomorrow noon. In the meantime, exporting in smaller batches may help. Support team'
Sign it Kestrel Support. And don't promise noon, say tomorrow afternoon. Send both.
Sent the DM to Arjun and posted the reply text in #ops for support to use, signed Kestrel Support, now promising an update by tomorrow afternoon.
set a tea reminder 4pm every weekday
Done: weekdays at 16:00, tea break. Tell me if a meeting should override it on a given day.
Make me a one-page rubric for the design interviews. Five criteria, each scored 1 to 5, and only about the work, nothing about the person.

Design interview rubric (score 1 to 5 each, based on the work shown):
1. Craft: quality and consistency of the visual work.
2. Problem framing: how clearly the problem was defined before design started.
3. Collaboration with developers: handoff, trade-offs, feedback loops.
4. Communication: clarity of the walkthrough and answers.
5. Product judgement: choices made for the user and the business, not only for looks.
Make it four criteria, merge product judgement into problem framing, and use a 1 to 4 scale.

Revised rubric (score 1 to 4 each):
1. Craft: quality and consistency of the visual work.
2. Problem framing and product judgement: how the problem was defined and what was chosen for user and business.
3. Collaboration with developers: handoff, trade-offs, feedback loops.
4. Communication: clarity of the walkthrough and answers.
I have saved it as the design hire rubric.

Arjun replied on the export escalation: the fix is in review and deploys tomorrow morning. He will confirm in #ops by 11:00 on Wednesday. Your holding reply already says tomorrow afternoon, so that holds.
New mail from Maya Rao, 'Proposal timeline'. She thanks you for the proposal and asks two scope questions: does phase 2 include the reporting module, and who owns data migration?
need arjun's view on migration first. not replying today
Holding the reply. Want me to ask Arjun to size the migration work?
yes, by thursday noon. I'll reply to maya next tuesday. remind me monday evening

Draft DM to Arjun: 'Arjun, Maya Rao at Acme asks who owns data migration and whether reporting is in phase 2. Before I answer, can you size migration by Thursday noon? Rough working days is enough. R.'
add what we'd need from acme. send
Sent with the addition: 'Rough working days, plus anything we would need from Acme.' Reminder set for Monday May 4 at 17:30: reply to Maya Rao on scope, target Tuesday May 5.
Change to the offsite: I'd rather do Thursday-Friday June 18-19 than the June 11-12 hold. Does that work around the Brightline renewal?

Yes. June 18-19 comes after the Brightline renewal on June 15, so the tier decision is made first, and the Friday would still end by 15:30 as you asked, inside your Friday rule. What budget do you have in mind, and should it be within driving distance of Mumbai?
June 18-19 it is, replacing 11-12. 60k all in, no flights, three hours' drive at most. Kavya likes quiet places so no big resort.

Saved: June offsite moved from June 11-12 to Thursday-Friday June 18-19, budget INR 60,000 all in for four people, no flights, within about three hours' drive of Mumbai, a quiet setting rather than a large resort. I cannot price venues from here. I can draft the questions to send them, if you want that next.
15 percent of 60k, buffer
9,000, which leaves 51,000 for venue, food and travel.
Priya should own the pricing review deck. Ask her for a first outline by Friday May 8.

Sent to Priya on Slack: 'Priya, could you own the deck for the pricing review? A first outline by Friday May 8 is enough. Kavya is pulling a competitor price comparison for the same day. The review itself will be later in May, 45 minutes with you, Arjun, Kavya and me. R.'
Maya Iyer asked if the footer scene can have two people instead of one. Fine by me, same fee. Note it.
Noted: the footer scene may have two characters, fee unchanged at INR 45,000. Do you want me to draft a reply to her?
no, I already told her
Understood, nothing to send.
will it rain on my way home
Showers are likely from about 19:00. If you leave at 18:00 you should be home before them.

End of day, Tuesday:
- Done: pricing approach session; Isha interview; export escalation handled (holding reply sent, Arjun's fix deploys Wednesday morning); Imran call booked for Thursday 17:15.
- Open: Maya Rao's scope questions are held until Arjun sizes migration (due Thursday noon); you reply Tuesday May 5.

- Tomorrow: interview feedback forms due; nothing after 15:00.
Sources: Calendar, Slack #ops, Mail, today's chat.
Fine. And tell me when Arjun confirms the export fix.
I will watch #ops for his confirmation and message you when it appears.
Write a short congratulations comment for Vikram, he just moved to a new company. Two lines.
'Congratulations, Vikram. A great move and well deserved. Wishing you a strong start, and let's catch up over coffee once you have settled in.'
drop the coffee line, too chatty for a public comment
'Congratulations, Vikram. A great move and well deserved. Wishing you a strong start.'
Is the Acme proposal still showing May 29 as the target?
Yes. Proposal v1, sent on April 25, states a delivery target of May 29, and that is the date I have on file for Acme.
what's tomorrow
Wednesday: brief at 08:30, Arjun's export confirmation by 11:00, feedback forms due by end of day with a 16:30 reminder. Nothing is booked after 15:00.
no wednesday gym, wednesdays are packed. thursday 7am as usual
No Wednesday gym. Thursday stays at 07:00, with a reminder at 06:30.

Dev Anand texted back. Thursday 11:30 or Friday 11:00. Thursday obviously, Friday we're shut.

3. Renewal terms: notice period, price lock, term length.
I can add a point on support response times if you want it.

when does brightline renew again
June 15. It is an annual plan.
Arjun confirmed in #ops: the export fix is deployed and exports on large projects are completing. Support will update the customer this afternoon.
thank him, short
Sent to Arjun: 'Thanks for the quick turnaround on the export fix. R.'
weather thursday
